cases.statement: One row: HA20-2 in Table S1 of 39167656, a singleton (no family) in a cohort of 34 individuals with HA20. No case description, sex, zygosity or phenotype is given.

people.label: HA20-2
people.key_phenotypes: not reported (listed in a table of patients with HA20)

quotes.quote: Table S1: Characteristics of patients with HA20.

phenotype_specificity.statement: not reported for this person. The paper describes the cohort only as individuals with HA20 carrying germline TNFAIP3 mutations.

quotes.quote: Peripheral blood of patients with germline TNFAIP3 mutations (in patient HA20-1 before and after treatment initiation) and 36 healthy control individuals was collected for scientific purposes after informed consent as approved by the ethics commission Halle (Saale) (project number 2014-75).

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Canonical splice-acceptor change (-2) at the intron 2 acceptor; protein not predictable from the cDNA alone (batch: p.?), and the paper gives no protein change ('intron 2'). The paper describes the disease as caused by heterozygous germline loss-of-function mutations.

quotes.quote: Haploinsufficiency of A20 (HA20) is a severe childhood-onset inflammatory disease characterized by heterozygous germline loss-of-function (LOF) mutations in TNFAIP3 (1, 2).

concerns: Table-only: the variant appears in a supplementary table row without a case description, phenotype, zygosity or method of genetic testing.
No protein consequence stated by the paper (written as 'intron 2'); no RNA study reported.
Whether HA20-2 was previously published elsewhere is not stated; the paper points to Infevers for already published HA20 variants.
notes_for_panel: Minimal evidence in this batch: one table row in a lymphocyte-repertoire study. The panel would need the original clinical report, if any, for case-level data.
